headline: Iceland's Blue Lagoon prepares initial public offering despite regional volcanic risks
summary: Geothermal spa resort Blue Lagoon is preparing an initial public offering on the Icelandic stock market while addressing operational continuity concerns from local volcanic activity.
why: The Blue Lagoon is one of Iceland's premier tourism assets, generating significant international leisure revenues.

impacts.name: Blue Lagoon
impacts.why: Public listing plans evaluate commercial growth potential against natural hazard operational risks.
